Definition: from the same as G2552; to undergo hardship:--be afflicted, endure afflictions (hardness), suffer trouble.
BiblicalUsage: Kakopatheo is to undergo hardship — to endure affliction for the gospel's sake. Paul says the word of God is not bound though he suffers trouble as an evildoer, and he charges Timothy to endure afflictions and do the work of an evangelist; and James says, is any among you afflicted, let him pray.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hardship is part of the calling, not an accident in it. Paul suffered it, Timothy was charged to endure it, and James turns the afflicted to prayer — and that is the pattern I follow when trouble comes.
